title: Chain of Thought Prompting

body.text: Chain of thought is having the AI
show its thinking step by step
— instead of jumping straight to the answer, tell the AI to 'think step by step' for more accurate results.

example: "Solve this math problem step by step: if you buy 3 items priced 120, 85, and 200 baht with a 15% discount, how much do you pay?"

title: Why chain of thought works well

body.text: Having the AI reason out the steps reduces
— great for complex problems like math, analysis, or decision-making.

example: "Analyze the pros and cons of renting vs buying a home, showing your reasoning point by point"
